'''Cunning of Tyranus''' was a unique [[red]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] named for the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], whose [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] title was [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus. When used in the construction of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], it [[Color/Legends|colored]] the blade red. Once tuned by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], it became a focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and could only be used in a lightsaber constructed by the individual who tuned it.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cunning of Tyranus appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Cunning of Tyranus was added to the game with the introduction of the "[[W:c:swg:Rare Loot System|Rare Loot System]]," released with the [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 17.10|Hotfix 17.10]] on [[October 7]], [[2010]].<ref name="H17.10">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68952&month=102010|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 17.10 -- Thursday, October 7, 2010}}</ref> This system allowed players to obtain increasingly rare items from any enemy in the game. Players of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] profession could use this crystal in their lightsaber, which gave the weapon a heat-based damage bonus.<ref name="SWG" />
